title: Pre-shift inspection for a supported scaffold.
officialText:
Prior to each shift the supported scaffold shall be inspected by
the competent person supervising the use of the scaffold in accordance with Section 3314.4.2.2 to verify the scaffold
remains in a safe condition for use. The results of the inspection shall be documented in a pre-shift inspection report signed
and dated by the person who performed the inspection. The scaffold shall not be used until it has passed such inspection and
the pre-shift inspection report has been completed.
Exception: An inspection report is not required for a supported scaffold that is not required to be designed under
Section 3314.3.1.
